description: Render a public webpage in a headless browser, capture it while scrolling (or static, or full-page), and encode the frames as GIF, animated WebP or APNG.

captureIntervalMs.description: Time between frames when capture mode is Hold still. Ignored while scrolling.
captureIntervalMs.title: Static frame interval (ms)

captureMode.description: How the page becomes an animation. Scroll down captures frames while moving through the page; Hold still records the visible window without scrolling; Full page records the whole page once.
captureMode.title: Capture mode

colorCount.description: Palette size for GIF output, from 2 to 256 colours. Lower values shrink the file; 256 preserves the most colour detail.
colorCount.title: GIF colours

colorScheme.description: Media colour scheme requested from the page. Use Dark to capture a site's dark theme when it supports one.
colorScheme.title: Preferred colour scheme

cookieWindowSelector.description: CSS selector of a cookie-consent dismiss button to click after page load (e.g. button[aria-label="Accept all"]). Skipped if not found.
cookieWindowSelector.title: Cookie consent selector

cropHeight.description: Height of the crop rectangle. 0 uses the remaining height from the top edge.
cropHeight.title: Crop height (px)

cropWidth.description: Width of the crop rectangle. 0 uses the remaining width from the left edge.
cropWidth.title: Crop width (px)

cropX.description: Left edge of a fixed crop rectangle in captured pixels. Any nonzero crop value activates cropping; 0 starts at the left edge.
cropX.title: Crop left (px)

cropY.description: Top edge of the crop rectangle. 0 starts at the top of the viewport (or full page).
cropY.title: Crop top (px)

deviceScaleFactor.description: Pixel density of the browser. 1 is a standard screen; 2 produces Retina-sharp frames at double resolution (larger output).
deviceScaleFactor.title: Device scale factor

dismissCookieBanners.description: Click common consent buttons and hide known consent containers (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Osano, Quantcast, CookieYes and similar) before capturing.
dismissCookieBanners.title: Auto-dismiss common cookie banners

dismissSelectors.description: Additional CSS selectors clicked in order before capture, such as consent buttons, pop-ups or tabs. Missing selectors add a warning and are skipped.
dismissSelectors.title: Selectors to click

downscaleFactor.description: Resize each frame down by this integer factor before encoding (1 = no resize, 2 = half, 3 = third). Higher values give smaller but softer files.
downscaleFactor.title: Downscale factor

finalFrameDelayMs.description: How long the last frame stays on screen. 0 uses the normal frame delay. A longer hold makes the bottom of the page readable.
finalFrameDelayMs.title: Last frame hold (ms)

frameDelayMs.description: Per-frame playback delay encoded into the animation.
frameDelayMs.title: Frame delay (ms)

freezeAnimations.description: Pause CSS keyframe animations while capturing. Gives repeatable frames for animated pages; leave off to record motion.
freezeAnimations.title: Freeze CSS animations

hideSelectors.description: CSS selectors of elements to hide with a style rule, such as chat widgets, sticky headers or banners. Applied before the page draws, so late banners are caught too.
hideSelectors.title: Selectors to hide

locale.description: Language/region used by the browser (e.g. en-US, de-DE, ja-JP). Leave en-US for English.
locale.title: Browser locale

loopCount.description: How many times the animation repeats. 0 loops forever.
loopCount.title: Loop count

maxFrames.description: Hard cap on captured frames. In scroll mode it protects very long pages; in static mode it is the number of frames recorded.
maxFrames.title: Max frames

outputFormat.description: Animation file format. GIF is the most compatible; WebP is much smaller and supports full colour and transparency; APNG is lossless full colour with wide browser support.
outputFormat.title: Output format

pageTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the page to load before the run fails.
pageTimeoutMs.title: Page load timeout (ms)

preloadLazyContent.description: Scroll through the whole page once before capturing, then return to the start. Makes below-the-fold lazy images and sections visible in the frames.
preloadLazyContent.title: Preload lazy content

scrollContainerSelector.description: Optional CSS selector of an element with its own scrollbar (for app-style layouts). Leave empty to scroll the page window.
scrollContainerSelector.title: Scroll container selector

scrollEndPx.description: Pixel offset where capture stops. 0 means the bottom of the page.
scrollEndPx.title: Stop scroll at (px)

scrollSettleMs.description: Pause after each scroll so lazy images and scroll-triggered content can render before the frame is captured.
scrollSettleMs.title: Settle time after scroll (ms)

scrollStartPx.description: Pixel offset from the top where capture starts. Use it to skip a hero section or header.
scrollStartPx.title: Start scroll at (px)

scrollStepPx.description: How many pixels to scroll between captured frames. Smaller values give smoother motion with more frames.
scrollStepPx.title: Scroll step (px)

url.description: Public page to capture. A full http(s) URL or a bare domain such as example.com.
url.title: Page URL

userAgent.description: Optional User-Agent header. Leave empty to use the actor's normal browser identity.
userAgent.title: Custom user agent

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before capturing (e.g. #main-content). If it never appears, the run continues and adds a warning.
waitForSelector.title: Wait for selector

waitForSelectorTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the selector above. 0 disables the wait.
waitForSelectorTimeoutMs.title: Selector wait timeout (ms)

waitToLoadPageMs.description: Additional milliseconds to wait after the page is ready and before captures start. Use for async or sliding content.
waitToLoadPageMs.title: Extra wait after load (ms)

waitUntil.description: When navigation counts as ready. DOM ready is fast; Load waits for images; Network idle waits for quiet network; Commit returns immediately.
waitUntil.title: Page ready signal

webpQuality.description: Quality for WebP output, from 1 (smallest) to 100 (sharpest). Ignored for GIF and APNG.
webpQuality.title: WebP quality

title: GIF Scroll Animation Input
